<thought>The isotopic pattern shows a primary peak at m/z 127.10 with successive peaks spaced ~1.003 Da apart, typical of 13C isotopes. The relative intensities (M+1 ≈ 8 %, M+2 ≈ 0.5 %) correspond to a molecule containing ~7–8 carbons. No characteristic chlorine, bromine, sulfur, nitrogen, or oxygen isotope patterns are evident. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
